attack.name: Attack
attack.description: A basic weapon strike. Unarmed attacks are weaker.

sword_slash.name: Sword Slash
sword_slash.description: A sweeping sword strike. Requires a sword.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Shield strike. 45% chance to stun for one turn; raises your guard.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: Mark for three rounds; all allies deal +6 damage. Triggers a primed nature blessing.

thornbind.name: Thornbind
thornbind.description: Nature damage. 75% chance to root for one enemy turn.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.description: Restore 15 HP now, then 12 HP at the end of each of the next three rounds. Recasting refreshes it.

dawn_avatar.name: Dawn Avatar
dawn_avatar.description: Paladin mythic; only usable with Paladin primary and its mythic node learned.

wild_hunt.name: Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.description: Ranger mythic; only usable with Ranger primary and its mythic node learned.

ancient_grove.name: Ancient Grove
ancient_grove.description: Druid mythic; only usable with Druid primary and its mythic node learned.

items.name: Items
items.description: Use one owned potion to restore up to 45 HP.

defend.name: Defend
defend.description: Halve incoming damage this round. With a shield, a block primes Guardian of the Wild.
